name: DUMBBELL SINGLE ARM OTIS UP LEFT
introduce: Lie on your back with your legs bent and feet flat on the floor. Hold a dumbbell in your left hand and extend your arm towards the ceiling. \n\nPlace your right hand on your chest. Slowly lift your upper body off the floor, then slowly lower it. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please control the speed, don\'t use momentum.
Exhale as you lift your upper body, and inhale as you lower it.
This is a great exercise for your rectus abdominis.
